predecessor.kept_for: the ordinary route and every Run frozen under it; its values are values of the approved item-rule definition and none of them carries over to this one

confirmation.counts: an item whose own text reports a merger, acquisition, disposition or business combination of a business or of an equity stake in one, to which the registrant or a subsidiary is party, announced, agreed or completed
confirmation.does_not_count: borrowing, note, credit or other financing agreements; tender offers for the registrant's own securities; share repurchases; compensation or employment agreements; use-of-proceeds statements; cooperation or settlement agreements with shareholders; transactions the registrant is not party to
confirmation.candidates: every item filed under a candidate code in the fiscal-year event window, read from its own text; keywords only help find candidates and never confirm one
confirmation.unconfirmed_candidates: a window with any candidate item whose confirmation is not registered is withheld by name; a window with no candidate item is answered zero
